summary: The authenticated production web prejoin for SHARE_TEST initially rendered the unavailable-roster/retrying state. A later automatic refresh cleared the error and rendered the empty-room state. The user-provided Flutter screenshot shows the same unavailable state, but a live Flutter retry was not performed. No voice join or microphone was started. This is consistent with a transient roster service/presence failure but does not establish the cause.

checks.name: Production web prejoin initial roster state
checks.observation: SHARE_TEST displayed 'состав недоступен' and 'Не удалось обновить состав комнаты. Повторяем попытку.' before voice admission.

checks.name: Automatic web roster recovery
checks.observation: Without joining voice, a later refresh cleared the unavailable state and displayed 'Голосовой канал пуст' / 'Пока никого нет.' The observed state was an empty room, not evidence of a populated roster.

checks.name: Flutter state recovery after an unavailable roster stream
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/app_state_test.dart && flutter analyze --no-pub test/app_state_test.dart
checks.observation: All 39 AppState tests pass and the changed test analyzes cleanly. A regression simulates a 503 followed by an authenticated SSE empty-room snapshot; Flutter retries, clears the error and retains the explicit empty roster.

checks.name: Flutter roster API, SSE parser and prejoin widget tests
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/voice_roster_api_test.dart test/voice_roster_events_test.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart
checks.observation: All 49 tests in the roster API, SSE parser and workspace/prejoin widget test files pass.

checks.name: Flutter live retry and cross-account presence transitions
checks.observation: The user supplied a Flutter screenshot with the unavailable state. A live device retry, second-account join/leave/share, and the 10-second SSE reconnect cadence were not tested.

checks.name: Voice and microphone safety
checks.observation: The production browser remained in prejoin; no voice connection or microphone was started.

remaining: Correlate a reproduced roster failure with server and LiveKit diagnostics, then verify recovery and ACL-correct populated snapshots on web and Flutter with two accounts. Do not treat an unavailable snapshot as an empty room.
